data.name: Vikashkumar
data.gender_notes: Vikashkumar is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Vikas means progress or development, and Kumar is a suffix indicating a young boy. So, Vikashkumar can be interpreted as 'One who brings development and growth in young age'. The name Vikashkumar carries the meaning “Knowledge Power” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Vikashkumar usually hope their child will grow to embody knowledge power and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vikashkumar is a name that symbolizes the awakening of inner wisdom and the pursuit of knowledge. It is a powerful name that signifies the growth and development of the soul.
data.etymology: Vikashkumar belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Knowledge Power.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vikashkumar total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

data.cultural_impact: The name Vikashkumar holds immense cultural significance, especially in the Hindu tradition. In Hindu culture, names are given based on various aspects of life, including the child's birth chart, family traditions, and spiritual beliefs. The name Vikashkumar reflects the value placed on education, personal growth, and progress in Hindu society. It is a name that inspires the bearer to strive for continuous improvement and development in all aspects of life.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Vikashkumar can symbolize the divine energy of growth and transformation within us. It reminds us of the potential for spiritual advancement that exists within each of us. The name can serve as a reminder to focus on inner growth and expansion, rather than external achievements or material possessions. It is a name that inspires one to seek knowledge, understanding, and wisdom in their spiritual journey.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Vikashkumar: Name of one who facilitates enlightenment (Vikas) and embodies the divine consciousness (Kumar) in his journey towards self-realization.

historical_references.reference: Vikramaditya was a famous Hindu king who ruled the Malwa region in India from approximately 570 to 631 AD. He is known for his patronage of art, literature and science, and his victories over the neighboring kingdoms. Vikashkumar could be a descendant of Vikramaditya, especially since 'Vikash' can be interpreted as a short form of 'Vikram'.

Another possible reference for the name Vikashkumar comes from the Bhagavata Purana, a Hindu scripture. In this text, King Vikashkumar is mentioned as a descendant of King Yudhishthira, the righteous ruler of the Pandava dynasty. The time period for this King Vikashkumar is not explicitly stated in the text, but it is mentioned that he had a son named Shantanu, who was the father of Bhishma, the grandsire of the Mahabharata epic.
historical_references.time_period: Unknown, but likely before 3000 BCE (based on Mahabharata)
